class.name: LLMModel
class.brief_description: Loads a GGUF model file for in-process LLM inference.
class.description: Wraps a llama.cpp [code]llama_model*[/code]. GPU acceleration is automatic and vendor-neutral via Vulkan on Linux, Windows, and Android (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel). macOS and iOS use Metal. Web builds run CPU-only. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var model = LLMModel.new() model.model_path = "/path/to/Qwen3.5-0.8B-heretic-Q4_K_M.gguf" model.n_gpu_layers = -1 # -1 = all layers on GPU model.load() [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: is_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the model is currently loaded.

method.name: load
method.description: Loads the model from [member model_path]. Returns [constant OK] on success. If [member model_path] is empty, defaults to [code]~/.cache/llm/Qwen3.5-0.8B-heretic-Q4_K_M.gguf[/code].

method.name: unload
method.description: Frees the loaded model and releases GPU/CPU memory.

members.member: Path to the GGUF model file. Accepts absolute or [code]res://[/code] paths.
Number of model layers to offload to GPU. [code]-1[/code] offloads all layers. Set to [code]0[/code] to force CPU-only inference.
Lock model weights in RAM to prevent them from being swapped out. Requires elevated permissions on some platforms.
Use memory-mapped file I/O for model loading. Reduces RAM usage when multiple processes share the same model file.

signal.name: load_failed
signal.description: Emitted when model loading fails. [param error] contains the error message.

signal.name: loaded
signal.description: Emitted when the model has been successfully loaded.
